The decisive mistake was WebSurfer's at step 8. It opened monday.com's management team page, but the viewport showed only 31% of it. It reported just four people (Roy Mann, Eran Zinman, Eliran Glazer, Shiran Nawi) without scrolling to the rest of the page. Yoni Osherov and Daniel Lereya were never captured, though both belong in the correct answer.

The Orchestrator then treated that partial list as the full current C-suite at step 9. Every later comparison used the incomplete list, which is how the run ended with only "Eliran Glazer, Shiran Nawi" as its answer.

AGENT: WebSurfer
STEP: 8
